preconditions.description: The number of clubs m and students n satisfy 1 <= m <= n <= 5000.

preconditions.expression: len(potentials) == n and all(0 <= x < 5000 for x in potentials)
preconditions.description: The list of potentials has length n, and each potential is an integer between 0 and 4999 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(clubs) == n and all(1 <= x <= m for x in clubs)
preconditions.description: The list of club assignments has length n, and each assignment is an integer between 1 and m inclusive.
The number of days d is between 1 and n inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(leaves) == d and all(1 <= x <= n for x in leaves)
preconditions.description: The list of leaving students has length d, and each student index is between 1 and n inclusive.
All student indices in the leaving sequence are distinct.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly d integers, one for each day.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= r <= n for r in results)
postconditions.description: Each result is a non-negative integer not exceeding the total number of students.

postconditions.expression: all(results[i] == max_mex(i, potentials, clubs, leaves[:i+1]) for i in range(d))
postconditions.description: For each day i (0-indexed), the output is the maximum possible team strength (mex) achievable after the first i+1 students have left, where max_mex computes the maximum mex of a team formed by selecting at most one student from each non-empty club among the remaining students.
